interface.shortDescription: A collaborative, cloud file system Codex can read and write to.
interface.longDescription: Arg is a collaborative, fast, cloud file system for humans and agents to work together. With this plugin, Codex connects to your Arg workspace over MCP and can read and write files natively — images, video, audio, presentations, documents, spreadsheets, databases, designs, whiteboards, and kanban boards. Each supported file type ships a skill with format-specific guidance so edits stay high fidelity.
defaultPrompt: Create a kanban board in Arg to plan my launch and add the first tasks
Read my design file in Arg and implement it in my codebase
Turn the spreadsheet in my Arg workspace into a summary document
